## agent-ml-research
ML research experiment management tools

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

content.content: {"result":"{\"success\": true, \"data\": {\"path\": \"/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_10/projects/provenance_weight_training/paper_framing.md\", \"content\": \"# Paper Framing — provenance_weight_training\\n\\n> 状态: STABLE (D023 dual-constraint + D029 ESS-only resolved + D035 τ sweep complete)\\n> 最后更新: 2026-05-15 21:30 UTC\\n> 投稿目标: EMNLP 2026 ARR May 25\\n\\n## Core Insight\\n\\nWeb 语料预训练面临合成数据污染问题（20-60%，来源未知），Drayson et al. (EMNLP 2025) 提出 w=(1-q)^b detect-and-reweight 框架，但 b 需要 per-model validation-based grid search（GPT-2/SmolLM ≤360M 用 b=10，SmolLM 1.7B 用 b=1）。\\n\\n我们提出 **dual-constrained adaptive b***：per-batch 从 q-score 分布推导最优 b*，同时满足两个约束：\\n- **α_eff(b) ≥ τ** — 质量下界：确保加权后有效真实率达到收敛理论要求的阈值（\\\"至少做够清洁\\\"）\\n- **ESS(b) ≥ n_min** — 稳定上界：确保有效样本量不低于 Kish 阈值（\\\"不要清洁过头\\\"）\\n\\nb* = inf{b ≥ 0 : α_eff(b) ≥ τ} subject to ESS(b) ≥ n_min — **最小干预准则**：在保证质量的前提下，使用最少的 downweighting。\\n\\n**关键洞察**：α_eff(b) 单调递增、ESS(b) 单调递减。α_eff 给出 b 的下界 b_τ（需至少这么多清洁），ESS 给出 b 的上界 b_ESS（最多这么多清洁）。当 b_τ < b_ESS（~40% reweighted batches），α_eff 是 binding constraint，b* 远小于 ESS 上界（mean 1.67 vs 4.15）——方法选择保守干预而非最大干预。\\n\\n实现路径：**直接 loss reweighting**（gradient 层面连续加权），vs Drayson 的 SIR resampling（离散重采样）。\\n\\n### α_eff(b) 的角色（D023 修正定论）\\n\\n**D021 证明 α_eff(b) 严格单调递增**（dα_eff/db = Cov_w(x, ln x) ≥ 0）——这是正确的。\\n\\n**D021 的错误推论**：\\\"因此 α_eff 优化等价于 ESS 阈值化\\\"——这假设优化目标是 max α_eff(b) s.t. ESS ≥ n_min。但实际优化是 **inf{b : α_eff(b) ≥ τ}**——最小满足质量阈值的 b。单调性恰恰保证了 b_τ 的**存在性和唯一性**。\\n\\n**Q1 实证（Reviewer 独立核实）**：\\n- 51,913 micro-batches 中，49.9% clean (b*=0), 20.2% α_eff binding, 30.0% ESS binding\\n- 在需 reweighting 的 batch 中：40.1% α_eff binding, 59.9% ESS binding\\n- α_eff binding 时 b*=1.67，ESS-only 方法会选 b*=4.15（2.5× 更激进）\\n- α_eff binding 时 ESS=2.60（vs n_min=2.0，有 30% 余量）\\n\\n**论文呈现**：α_eff 是方法的核心组件（非仅 motivation），提供质量阈值约束。Figure: 双轴图展示 α_eff(b) 和 ESS(b) 曲线 + b_τ 和 b_ESS 标注。\\n\\n**τ 的定位（D025 定论 + D035 τ sweep 完整数据更新）**：收敛理论 (arXiv 2602.16065) 中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是已知设计参数，推导依赖已知比例。τ **不能声称有 proportion-free 的理论推导**。正确定位：empirical hyperparameter with theoretical motivation——收敛理论解释了\\\"为什么需要质量阈值\\\"（α 越高收敛越快），但 τ 的特定值由经验确定。\\n\\n**τ sweep 完整结果（6 点，seed42，ρ=0.4）**：\\n\\n| τ | PPL | Δ vs uniform (17.694) | b* mean | conclusion |\\n|---|-----|----------------------|---------|------------|\\n| 0.50 | 17.688 | −0.006 | 0.39 | success |\\n| 0.60 | 17.681 | −0.013 | 0.59 | success |\\n| 0.70 | 17.679 | −0.015 | 0.89 | success |\\n| **0.80** | **17.653** | **−0.041** | **1.40** | **best** |\\n| 0.90 | 17.712 | +0.018 | 2.36 | negative |\\n| 0.95 | 17.723 | +0.029 | 3.08 | negative |\\n\\n**关键洞察**：(1) [0.5, 0.8] 全部 beat uniform，safe range 内 PPL 差异仅 0.035；(2) τ=0.8 是最优默认值；(3) τ>0.8 因 b* 膨胀导致过度 downweighting 而退化（asymmetric sensitivity）；(4) b* 与 τ 严格单调递增，机制清晰——τ 越高要求越严，solver 被迫推高 b*。不能说\\\"τ 不敏感\\\"，正确表述：\\\"wide safe range [0.5, 0.8] with principled default τ=0.8\\\"。\\n\\n**ESS-only baseline 已验证 (D029)**：ESS-only PPL=17.728（+0.034 vs uniform，+0.076 vs adaptive_fix）——max-intervention 退化确认，min-intervention (dual) 明确优于 max-intervention (ESS-only)。ess_only_seed123/456 跨 seed 验证进行中。\\n\\n## Positioning vs Prior Work\\n\\n### Drayson et al. (EMNLP 2025) — 最近相关工作\\n\\n**共同点**：同一加权公式 w=(1-q)^b，detect-and-reweight 范式。\\n\\n**关键区分**：\\n\\n| 维度 | Drayson et al. | Ours |\\n|------|---------------|------|\\n| **b 选择** | 验证集 empirical 选取，训练中固定 | α_eff + ESS 双重约束自适应推导，per-batch 动态 |\\n| **干预原则** | 无原则（b 是超参数） | 最小干预（inf{b : α_eff ≥ τ}，只做必要的清洁） |\\n| **实现路径** | SIR resampling（离散重采样） | Loss reweighting（连续梯度加权） |\\n| **污染设置** | 不假设已知比例，但 b 依赖 validation set | 仅需 detector scores，无 validation set |\\n| **检测器** | ModernBERT 150M (AUC=0.986) | TF-IDF + LR (AUC=0.939)，轻量即可 |\\n| **训练场景** | 递归训练 model collapse prevention | Web corpus 一次性预训练 |\\n| **数据规模** | WikiText-2 (~2M tokens) | FineWeb subset (132M+ tokens) |\\n| **validation 成本** | 需 per-model validation run | 零额外 validation cost |\\n\\n**定位原则：complementary approaches for different settings。**\\n\\n### Golden Ratio Weighting (arXiv 2502.18049, 2025)\\n理论最优 w*=1/φ，但假设已知 real/synthetic 比例 k。作为 oracle baseline。\\n\\n### 其他相关工作\\n- **Strong Model Collapse (ICLR 2025)** — 理论动机：微量合成数据即致 collapse\\n- **Dynamic Loss-Based Reweighting (ICLR 2025)** — 按 loss 加权（不使用 detector score），互补\\n- **SoftDedup (ACL 2024)** — 基于重复度的 soft reweighting\\n- **DoReMi / DSIR (NeurIPS 2023)** — 域级优化 vs 我们的实例级\\n- **Beyond Model Collapse / Verification (NeurIPS 2025)** — verifier-based prevention\\n- **PSIS (Pareto Smoothed IS)** — 重要性采样诊断，Kish's ESS 理论来源\\n- **arXiv 2602.16065** — α_eff 质量阈值 τ 的收敛理论来源\\n\\n## Core Claims\\n\\n### Claim 1 (Primary): Dual-Constrained Adaptive b* — Minimum Intervention Principle\\n\\nα_eff + ESS 双重约束的 adaptive b*，提供 contamination-aware reweighting 中权重指数的 **principled 推导**，替代 Drayson et al. 的 per-model empirical grid search。\\n\\n- **方法核心**：b* = inf{b ≥ 0 : α_eff(b) ≥ τ} s.t. ESS(b) ≥ n_min。两个约束分别提供 b 的下界（质量）和上界（稳定），b* 是最小满足质量阈值的可行解\\n- **最小干预原则**：不 downweight 更多于必要——在 ~40% reweighted batch 中，b* 仅为 ESS-only 上界的 45%，保留显著更多有效样本\\n- **差异化**：Drayson 的 b 是超参数（需 validation + grid search）；我们的 b* 是双约束下的自适应推导\\n- **证据需求**：(a) α_eff binding 比例统计 (✓ Q1); (b) ESS-only baseline head-to-head 对比（证明 min > max intervention）; (c) b* 轨迹分析\\n- **理论 motivation**：α_eff(b) 单调性保证 b_τ 唯一存在；收敛理论为 τ 选择提供指导\\n\\n### Claim 2 (Primary): Adaptive b* 免调参即匹配 Grid-best\\n\\nAdaptive b* 在零超参调优下达到 grid-search 最优同等水平（within seed variance），消除 grid search 的计算开销（6N → 1 runs）。\\n\\n- **MVP 证据**: adaptive_fix ×3 seeds vs grid-b ×3 seeds（40% 污染, Qwen3-0.6B, 200M tokens）\\n- **状态**: ✅ MVP Path B PASS (D019: aggregate 88.6%, 三支柱论证)\\n\\n**叙事弹性**：\\n- 核心表述：**\\\"adaptive matches grid-best within seed variance\\\"**\\n- 补充表述：**\\\"eliminates grid search cost (6N → 1 runs)\\\"** + **\\\"consistent improvement across all seeds\\\"**\\n\\n**MVP 数据**：\\n\\n| Metric | seed42 | seed123 | seed456 |\\n|--------|--------|---------|---------|\\n| Uniform PPL | 17.690 | 17.690 | 17.700 |\\n| Grid-best PPL (b=0.5) | 17.651 | 17.638 | 17.650 |\\n| Adaptive_fix PPL | 17.650 | 17.643 | 17.660 |\\n| Ratio | 102.6% | 90.4% | 80.0% |\\n\\nAggregate ratio: 88.6% (D019). Path B PASS.\\n\\n### Claim 3 (Setting): Unknown Contamination Proportion\\n\\n方法仅需 detector scores，无需已知污染比例、无需 clean validation set。\\n\\n- **差异化**：Golden Ratio 需已知比例 k；Drayson 的 b 依赖 validation set；我们仅需 per-sample q-scores\\n- **实际意义**：web-scale pretraining 中污染比例本质不可知\\n- **D021 代码修复**: ✅ τ = 0.8 固定 CLI 参数，不依赖 contamination_ratio\\n- **D025 理论审计**: arXiv 2602.16065 的 α 是已知比例，τ 不能声称有 proportion-free 理论推导。τ 定位为 empirical hyperparameter with theoretical motivation\\n- **D035 τ sweep 完整数据 (6 点)**：[0.5, 0.8] 为 safe range（all beat uniform，PPL 差异 <0.035），τ=0.8 为最优默认值；τ>0.8 因 b* 膨胀退化。正确表述：\\\"wide safe range with principled default\\\"，不说\\\"insensitive\\\"\\n- **Claim 3 核心仍成立**：b* 推导不需要已知比例（ESS 和 α_eff 从 batch 统计量计算），方法运行时不访问 contamination_ratio。τ 在 [0.5, 0.8] 范围内是 robust empirical default，类似于 learning rate warmup steps——有理论 motivation 但具体值凭经验，且有明确的有效范围上界\\n\\n## Ancillary Finding: Lightweight Detector Sufficiency\\n\\nTF-IDF + LR (AUC=0.939) 即可支撑有效的 adaptive reweighting，不需要 ModernBERT 级别的强检测器（Drayson 用 AUC=0.986）。q-score 的连续性（calibration）比分类精度（AUC）更重要。\\n\\n可升级为 co-primary contribution 如果 detector quality ablation 显示明确的 \\\"sufficiency threshold\\\"。\\n\\n## n_min Robustness Framing\\n\\nESS 约束的 n_min 是 adaptive b* 的超参数之一（另一个是 τ）。\\n\\n- n_min=3 at batch_size=4 → ESS 约束过紧，b* 被钳制在低值，seed42 零改善\\n- n_min=2 at batch_size=4 → 稳定工作，3/3 seeds positive\\n- **论文呈现**：n_min sensitivity curve (n_min=1,2,3,4,5) + batch_size 消融 (4,8,16) 证明 knife-edge 是 batch_size=4 的 artifact\\n\\n## Narrative Structure\\n\\n**起点**: Web 语料 20-60% 为合成文本，比例未知——Strong Model Collapse (ICLR 2025) 证明微量污染即破坏 scaling law。\\n\\n**现有方法不足**：Drayson 的 b 依赖 per-model validation（不同模型需不同 b），Golden Ratio 假设已知混合比例。\\n\\n**我们的方案**: Dual-constrained adaptive ## Core Insight

Web 语料预训练面临合成数据污染问题（20-60%，来源未知），Drayson et al. (EMNLP 2025) 提出 w=(1-q)^b detect-and-reweight 框架，但 b 需要 per-model validation-based grid search（GPT-2/SmolLM ≤360M 用 b=10，SmolLM 1.7B 用 b=1）。

我们提出 **dual-constrained adaptive b***：per-batch 从 q-score 分布推导最优 b*，同时满足两个约束：
- **α_eff(b) ≥ τ** — 质量下界：确保加权后有效真实率达到收敛理论要求的阈值（"至少做够清洁"）
- **ESS(b) ≥ n_min** — 稳定上界：确保有效样本量不低于 Kish 阈值（"不要清洁过头"）

b* = inf{b ≥ 0 : α_eff(b) ≥ τ} subject to ESS(b) ≥ n_min — **最小干预准则**：在保证质量的前提下，使用最少的 downweighting。

**关键洞察**：α_eff(b) 单调递增、ESS(b) 单调递减。α_eff 给出 b 的下界 b_τ（需至少这么多清洁），ESS 给出 b 的上界 b_ESS（最多这么多清洁）。当 b_τ < b_ESS（~40% reweighted batches），α_eff 是 binding constraint，b* 远小于 ESS 上界（mean 1.67 vs 4.15）——方法选择保守干预而非最大干预。

实现路径：**直接 loss reweighting**（gradient 层面连续加权），vs Drayson 的 SIR resampling（离散重采样）。

### α_eff(b) 的角色（D023 修正定论）

**D021 证明 α_eff(b) 严格单调递增**（dα_eff/db = Cov_w(x, ln x) ≥ 0）——这是正确的。

**D021 的错误推论**："因此 α_eff 优化等价于 ESS 阈值化"——这假设优化目标是 max α_eff(b) s.t. ESS ≥ n_min。但实际优化是 **inf{b : α_eff(b) ≥ τ}**——最小满足质量阈值的 b。单调性恰恰保证了 b_τ 的**存在性和唯一性**。

**Q1 实证（Reviewer 独立核实）**：
- 51,913 micro-batches 中，49.9% clean (b*=0), 20.2% α_eff binding, 30.0% ESS binding
- 在需 reweighting 的 batch 中：40.1% α_eff binding, 59.9% ESS binding
- α_eff binding 时 b*=1.67，ESS-only 方法会选 b*=4.15（2.5× 更激进）
- α_eff binding 时 ESS=2.60（vs n_min=2.0，有 30% 余量）

**论文呈现**：α_eff 是方法的核心组件（非仅 motivation），提供质量阈值约束。Figure: 双轴图展示 α_eff(b) 和 ESS(b) 曲线 + b_τ 和 b_ESS 标注。

**τ 的定位（D025 定论 + D035 τ sweep 完整数据更新）**：收敛理论 (arXiv 2602.16065) 中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是已知设计参数，推导依赖已知比例。τ **不能声称有 proportion-free 的理论推导**。正确定位：empirical hyperparameter with theoretical motivation——收敛理论解释了"为什么需要质量阈值"（α 越高收敛越快），但 τ 的特定值由经验确定。

**τ sweep 完整结果（6 点，seed42，ρ=0.4）**：

| τ | PPL | Δ vs uniform (17.694) | b* mean | conclusion |
|---|-----|----------------------|---------|------------|
| 0.50 | 17.688 | −0.006 | 0.39 | success |
| 0.60 | 17.681 | −0.013 | 0.59 | success |
| 0.70 | 17.679 | −0.015 | 0.89 | success |
| **0.80** | **17.653** | **−0.041** | **1.40** | **best** |
| 0.90 | 17.712 | +0.018 | 2.36 | negative |
| 0.95 | 17.723 | +0.029 | 3.08 | negative |

**关键洞察**：(1) [0.5, 0.8] 全部 beat uniform，safe range 内 PPL 差异仅 0.035；(2) τ=0.8 是最优默认值；(3) τ>0.8 因 b* 膨胀导致过度 downweighting 而退化（asymmetric sensitivity）；(4) b* 与 τ 严格单调递增，机制清晰——τ 越高要求越严，solver 被迫推高 b*。不能说"τ 不敏感"，正确表述："wide safe range [0.5, 0.8] with principled default τ=0.8"。

**ESS-only baseline 已验证 (D029)**：ESS-only PPL=17.728（+0.034 vs uniform，+0.076 vs adaptive_fix）——max-intervention 退化确认，min-intervention (dual) 明确优于 max-intervention (ESS-only)。ess_only_seed123/456 跨 seed 验证进行中。

## Positioning vs Prior Work

### Drayson et al. (EMNLP 2025) — 最近相关工作

**共同点**：同一加权公式 w=(1-q)^b，detect-and-reweight 范式。

**关键区分**：

| 维度 | Drayson et al. | Ours |
|------|---------------|------|
| **b 选择** | 验证集 empirical 选取，训练中固定 | α_eff + ESS 双重约束自适应推导，per-batch 动态 |
| **干预原则** | 无原则（b 是超参数） | 最小干预（inf{b : α_eff ≥ τ}，只做必要的清洁） |
| **实现路径** | SIR resampling（离散重采样） | Loss reweighting（连续梯度加权） |
| **污染设置** | 不假设已知比例，但 b 依赖 validation set | 仅需 detector scores，无 validation set |
| **检测器** | ModernBERT 150M (AUC=0.986) | TF-IDF + LR (AUC=0.939)，轻量即可 |
| **训练场景** | 递归训练 model collapse prevention | Web corpus 一次性预训练 |
| **数据规模** | WikiText-2 (~2M tokens) | FineWeb subset (132M+ tokens) |
| **validation 成本** | 需 per-model validation run | 零额外 validation cost |

**定位原则：complementary approaches for different settings。**

### Golden Ratio Weighting (arXiv 2502.18049, 2025)
理论最优 w*=1/φ，但假设已知 real/synthetic 比例 k。作为 oracle baseline。

### 其他相关工作
- **Strong Model Collapse (ICLR 2025)** — 理论动机：微量合成数据即致 collapse
- **Dynamic Loss-Based Reweighting (ICLR 2025)** — 按 loss 加权（不使用 detector score），互补
- **SoftDedup (ACL 2024)** — 基于重复度的 soft reweighting
- **DoReMi / DSIR (NeurIPS 2023)** — 域级优化 vs 我们的实例级
- **Beyond Model Collapse / Verification (NeurIPS 2025)** — verifier-based prevention
- **PSIS (Pareto Smoothed IS)** — 重要性采样诊断，Kish's ESS 理论来源
- **arXiv 2602.16065** — α_eff 质量阈值 τ 的收敛理论来源

## Core Claims

### Claim 1 (Primary): Dual-Constrained Adaptive b* — Minimum Intervention Principle

α_eff + ESS 双重约束的 adaptive b*，提供 contamination-aware reweighting 中权重指数的 **principled 推导**，替代 Drayson et al. 的 per-model empirical grid search。

- **方法核心**：b* = inf{b ≥ 0 : α_eff(b) ≥ τ} s.t. ESS(b) ≥ n_min。两个约束分别提供 b 的下界（质量）和上界（稳定），b* 是最小满足质量阈值的可行解
- **最小干预原则**：不 downweight 更多于必要——在 ~40% reweighted batch 中，b* 仅为 ESS-only 上界的 45%，保留显著更多有效样本
- **差异化**：Drayson 的 b 是超参数（需 validation + grid search）；我们的 b* 是双约束下的自适应推导
- **证据需求**：(a) α_eff binding 比例统计 (✓ Q1); (b) ESS-only baseline head-to-head 对比（证明 min > max intervention）; (c) b* 轨迹分析
- **理论 motivation**：α_eff(b) 单调性保证 b_τ 唯一存在；收敛理论为 τ 选择提供指导

### Claim 2 (Primary): Adaptive b* 免调参即匹配 Grid-best

Adaptive b* 在零超参调优下达到 grid-search 最优同等水平（within seed variance），消除 grid search 的计算开销（6N → 1 runs）。

- **MVP 证据**: adaptive_fix ×3 seeds vs grid-b ×3 seeds（40% 污染, Qwen3-0.6B, 200M tokens）
- **状态**: ✅ MVP Path B PASS (D019: aggregate 88.6%, 三支柱论证)

**叙事弹性**：
- 核心表述：**"adaptive matches grid-best within seed variance"**
- 补充表述：**"eliminates grid search cost (6N → 1 runs)"** + **"consistent improvement across all seeds"**

**MVP 数据**：

| Metric | seed42 | seed123 | seed456 |
|--------|--------|---------|---------|
| Uniform PPL | 17.690 | 17.690 | 17.700 |
| Grid-best PPL (b=0.5) | 17.651 | 17.638 | 17.650 |
| Adaptive_fix PPL | 17.650 | 17.643 | 17.660 |
| Ratio | 102.6% | 90.4% | 80.0% |

Aggregate ratio: 88.6% (D019). Path B PASS.

### Claim 3 (Setting): Unknown Contamination Proportion

方法仅需 detector scores，无需已知污染比例、无需 clean validation set。

- **差异化**：Golden Ratio 需已知比例 k；Drayson 的 b 依赖 validation set；我们仅需 per-sample q-scores

- **Claim 3 核心仍成立**：b* 推导不需要已知比例（ESS 和 α_eff 从 batch 统计量计算），方法运行时不访问 contamination_ratio。τ 在 [0.5, 0.8] 范围内是 robust empirical default，类似于 learning rate warmup steps——有理论 motivation 但具体值凭经验，且有明确的有效范围上界

TF-IDF + LR (AUC=0.939) 即可支撑有效的 adaptive reweighting，不需要 ModernBERT 级别的强检测器（Drayson 用 AUC=0.986）。q-score 的连续性（calibration）比分类精度（AUC）更重要。

可升级为 co-primary contribution 如果 detector quality ablation 显示明确的 "sufficiency threshold"。

## n_min Robustness Framing

ESS 约束的 n_min 是 adaptive b* 的超参数之一（另一个是 τ）。

- n_min=3 at batch_size=4 → ESS 约束过紧，b* 被钳制在低值，seed42 零改善
- n_min=2 at batch_size=4 → 稳定工作，3/3 seeds positive
- **论文呈现**：n_min sensitivity curve (n_min=1,2,3,4,5) + batch_size 消融 (4,8,16) 证明 knife-edge 是 batch_size=4 的 artifact

**起点**: Web 语料 20-60% 为合成文本，比例未知——Strong Model Collapse (ICLR 2025) 证明微量污染即破坏 scaling law。

- id: wang_2026_survive_contamination
  title: "Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training"
  authors: "Kevin Wang, Hongqian Niu, Didong Li"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2602.16065"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16065"
  category: theoretical-foundation
  role: "τ（α_eff 质量下界阈值）的理论动机来源；在通用框架下证明污染递归训练仍然收敛"
  method_summary: >
    在最小假设（不限数据分布、允许通用逼近器生成模型）下研究递归训练。
    证明收敛率 = min(基线模型收敛率, α)，其中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是每轮真实数据比例。
    首个不依赖分布假设的递归训练正面理论结果。进一步扩展到采样偏差场景。
  key_findings: "收敛率由真实数据比例 α 下界控制；α 越大收敛越快；即使有污染，只要 α > 0 训练仍收敛"
  tension_with_our_work: >
    论文中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是**已知设计参数**（依赖已知的真实/合成数据比例），
    而我们的 τ 是 empirical hyperparameter（通过检测器统计量在线估计）。
    与 Claim 3（proportion-free）存在张力：Wang 的理论要求知道 α，
    我们的方法不假设已知比例，而是通过 α_eff(b) 间接逼近。
    需在论文中明确讨论：我们的 τ 是 α 的 principled proxy，而非精确值。
  relevance_to_us: "为 α_eff 阈值提供理论合理性——收敛保证依赖真实数据有效比例，我们的 b* 选取正是为了保证 α_eff(b) ≥ τ"

2	
3	\paragraph{Synthetic Contamination and Model Collapse.}
4	Training on recursively generated data leads to irreversible quality degradation---\emph{model collapse}~\citep{shumailov_2024_model_collapse}.
5	\citet{alemohammad_2024_mad} formalize this as Model Autophagy Disorder, showing that quality or diversity inevitably degrades without fresh real data, even when original training data is retained.
6	More critically, \citet{dohmatob_2025_strong_collapse} prove under scaling-law regimes that even a vanishingly small synthetic fraction (e.g., $1/1000$) suffices to trigger collapse, ruling out data scaling as a remedy.
7	\citet{cheng_2025_contamination_survey} survey the broader contamination landscape, confirming that synthetic content now constitutes an estimated 20--60\% of web corpora.
8	These results motivate \emph{contamination-aware} training strategies that explicitly account for synthetic provenance rather than treating all tokens equally.
9	
10	\paragraph{Detection and Filtering of Machine-Generated Text.}
11	Given the severity of contamination, a natural response is to detect and remove synthetic content.
12	DetectGPT~\citep{mitchell_2023_detectgpt} performs zero-shot detection via probability curvature, while Min-$k$\% Prob~\citep{shi_2024_minkprob} uses the average log-probability of the lowest-$k$\% tokens as a reference-free signal.
13	Both produce continuous confidence scores suitable as input to downstream weighting---including ours.
14	On the mitigation side, \citet{feng_2025_beyond_collapse} prove that even an imperfect verifier prevents collapse, but apply hard binary filtering that discards borderline samples.
15	\citet{guo_2025_escaping_collapse} similarly rely on verification-based selection.
16	Hard filtering requires a precision--recall threshold; soft reweighting avoids this trade-off by assigning continuous weights.
17	
18	Most directly related to our work, \citet{drayson_2025_detection_collapse} propose $w_j = (1{-}q_j)^b$ for collapse prevention via detect-and-reweight, where $q_j$ is the detector's synthetic probability.
19	We adopt the same weighting formula but differ in several fundamental ways.
20	\textbf{(i)}~Drayson et al.\ select $b$ via validation-set grid search and fix it throughout training; different model scales require different values ($b{=}10$ for ${\leq}360$M, $b{=}1$ for 1.7B), making the choice \emph{per-model} and expensive.
21	Our $b^*$ is derived per-batch from dual constraints ($\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}} \geq \tau$, $\mathrm{ESS} \geq n_{\min}$) at zero validation cost.
22	\textbf{(ii)}~Their SIR resampling discretizes the weight distribution; we apply direct loss reweighting with continuous gradients.
23	\textbf{(iii)}~They employ a ModernBERT-150M detector (AUC\,=\,0.986) on WikiText-2 (${\sim}$2M tokens); we show that a lightweight TF-IDF+LR detector (AUC\,=\,0.939) suffices on FineWeb-scale data (132M+ tokens), suggesting that score calibration matters more than raw detection accuracy.
24	
25	\paragraph{Data Mixing and Instance-Level Reweighting.}
26	A parallel line of work optimizes data composition without targeting synthetic contamination.
27	At the \emph{domain} level, DoReMi~\citep{xie_2023_doremi} learns mixture weights via Group DRO with a proxy model, DSIR~\citep{xie_2023_dsir} performs importance resampling with $n$-gram features, and \citet{ye_2025_data_mixing_laws} discover predictable functional forms relating mixing ratios to performance.
28	AIOLI~\citep{chen_2025_aioli} unifies these into an online adaptive framework, while \citet{yang_2026_data_mixing_agent} train an RL agent for domain-weight selection.
29	These methods do not address instance-level contamination within a domain.
30	At the \emph{instance} level, SoftDedup~\citep{he_2024_softdedup} downweights high-frequency samples via $n$-gram commonness, \citet{sow_2025_dynamic_reweighting} derive sample weights from per-sample loss with convergence guarantees, and \citet{kuo_2024_data_weighting} show that differentiated weighting of LLM-generated data improves downstream classification.
31	Our reweighting differs from all of these in being driven by \emph{provenance}---detector scores estimating human vs.\ synthetic origin---rather than loss, frequency, or domain membership.
32	
33	\paragraph{Theoretical Foundations.}
34	\citet{he_2025_golden_ratio} derive the optimal real-data weight under known mixture proportions, finding the golden-ratio reciprocal (${\approx}0.62$) optimal when both sources are equally sized.
35	Their result requires the contamination ratio $k$, unavailable in web-scale settings; we use it as an oracle baseline.
36	\citet{wang_2026_survive_contamination} prove that contaminated recursive training converges at a rate governed by the effective real-data fraction $\alpha$, providing the theoretical motivation for our quality threshold: ensuring $\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}(b) \geq \tau$ guarantees a convergence-rate lower bound.
37	We operationalize this without the known-proportion assumption, estimating $\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}$ from batch-level statistics online.
38	For the stability constraint, we build on Kish's effective sample size and the Pareto-smoothed importance sampling framework of \citet{vehtari_2024_psis}.
39	\citet{kimura_2024_iw_survey} provide a broader treatment of importance weighting under distribution shift, within which our provenance-based reweighting can be viewed as a special case of covariate-shift correction where the covariate is synthetic origin probability.

\section{Related Work}

\paragraph{Synthetic Contamination and Model Collapse.}
Training on recursively generated data leads to irreversible quality degradation---\emph{model collapse}~\citep{shumailov_2024_model_collapse}.
\citet{alemohammad_2024_mad} formalize this as Model Autophagy Disorder, showing that quality or diversity inevitably degrades without fresh real data, even when original training data is retained.
More critically, \citet{dohmatob_2025_strong_collapse} prove under scaling-law regimes that even a vanishingly small synthetic fraction (e.g., $1/1000$) suffices to trigger collapse, ruling out data scaling as a remedy.
\citet{cheng_2025_contamination_survey} survey the broader contamination landscape, confirming that synthetic content now constitutes an estimated 20--60\% of web corpora.
These results motivate \emph{contamination-aware} training strategies that explicitly account for synthetic provenance rather than treating all tokens equally.

\paragraph{Detection and Filtering of Machine-Generated Text.}
Given the severity of contamination, a natural response is to detect and remove synthetic content.
DetectGPT~\citep{mitchell_2023_detectgpt} performs zero-shot detection via probability curvature, while Min-$k$\% Prob~\citep{shi_2024_minkprob} uses the average log-probability of the lowest-$k$\% tokens as a reference-free signal.
Both produce continuous confidence scores suitable as input to downstream weighting---including ours.
On the mitigation side, \citet{feng_2025_beyond_collapse} prove that even an imperfect verifier prevents collapse, but apply hard binary filtering that discards borderline samples.
\citet{guo_2025_escaping_collapse} similarly rely on verification-based selection.
Hard filtering requires a precision--recall threshold; soft reweighting avoids this trade-off by assigning continuous weights.

Most directly related to our work, \citet{drayson_2025_detection_collapse} propose $w_j = (1{-}q_j)^b$ for collapse prevention via detect-and-reweight, where $q_j$ is the detector's synthetic probability.
We adopt the same weighting formula but differ in several fundamental ways.
\textbf{(i)}~Drayson et al.\ select $b$ via validation-set grid search and fix it throughout training; different model scales require different values ($b{=}10$ for ${\leq}360$M, $b{=}1$ for 1.7B), making the choice \emph{per-model} and expensive.
Our $b^*$ is derived per-batch from dual constraints ($\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}} \geq \tau$, $\mathrm{ESS} \geq n_{\min}$) at zero validation cost.
\textbf{(ii)}~Their SIR resampling discretizes the weight distribution; we apply direct loss reweighting with continuous gradients.
\textbf{(iii)}~They employ a ModernBERT-150M detector (AUC\,=\,0.986) on WikiText-2 (${\sim}$2M tokens); we show that a lightweight TF-IDF+LR detector (AUC\,=\,0.939) suffices on FineWeb-scale data (132M+ tokens), suggesting that score calibration matters more than raw detection accuracy.

\paragraph{Data Mixing and Instance-Level Reweighting.}
A parallel line of work optimizes data composition without targeting synthetic contamination.
At the \emph{domain} level, DoReMi~\citep{xie_2023_doremi} learns mixture weights via Group DRO with a proxy model, DSIR~\citep{xie_2023_dsir} performs importance resampling with $n$-gram features, and \citet{ye_2025_data_mixing_laws} discover predictable functional forms relating mixing ratios to performance.
AIOLI~\citep{chen_2025_aioli} unifies these into an online adaptive framework, while \citet{yang_2026_data_mixing_agent} train an RL agent for domain-weight selection.
These methods do not address instance-level contamination within a domain.
At the \emph{instance} level, SoftDedup~\citep{he_2024_softdedup} downweights high-frequency samples via $n$-gram commonness, \citet{sow_2025_dynamic_reweighting} derive sample weights from per-sample loss with convergence guarantees, and \citet{kuo_2024_data_weighting} show that differentiated weighting of LLM-generated data improves downstream classification.
Our reweighting differs from all of these in being driven by \emph{provenance}---detector scores estimating human vs.\ synthetic origin---rather than loss, frequency, or domain membership.

\paragraph{Theoretical Foundations.}
\citet{he_2025_golden_ratio} derive the optimal real-data weight under known mixture proportions, finding the golden-ratio reciprocal (${\approx}0.62$) optimal when both sources are equally sized.
Their result requires the contamination ratio $k$, unavailable in web-scale settings; we use it as an oracle baseline.
\citet{wang_2026_survive_contamination} prove that contaminated recursive training converges at a rate governed by the effective real-data fraction $\alpha$, providing the theoretical motivation for our quality threshold: ensuring $\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}(b) \geq \tau$ guarantees a convergence-rate lower bound.
We operationalize this without the known-proportion assumption, estimating $\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}$ from batch-level statistics online.
For the stability constraint, we build on Kish's effective sample size and the Pareto-smoothed importance sampling framework of \citet{vehtari_2024_psis}.
\citet{kimura_2024_iw_survey} provide a broader treatment of importance weighting under distribution shift, within which our provenance-based reweighting can be viewed as a special case of covariate-shift correction where the covariate is synthetic origin probability.

- id: drayson_2025_detection_collapse
  title: "Machine-Generated Text Detection Prevents Language Model Collapse"
  authors: "George Drayson, Emine Yilmaz, Vasileios Lampos"
  venue: "EMNLP 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.15654"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15654"
  github: "https://github.com/GeorgeDrayson/model_collapse"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "使用同一公式 w=(1-q)^b 进行重加权，但 b 为验证集 empirical 选取，训练中固定"
  method_summary: >
    Detect-and-reweight 防止递归训练 model collapse。检测器为 ModernBERT 150M
    (MAGE fine-tune, in-domain AUC=0.986, OOD AUC=0.943)。权重公式 wⱼ=(1-q(xⱼ))^b / Σₗ(1-q(xₗ))^b，
    通过 SIR 按权重重采样训练数据。b 通过 WikiText-2 验证集上 1 代递归训练后评估选取
    (GPT-2/SmolLM 135M/360M 用 b=10, SmolLM 1.7B 用 b=1)，训练全程固定。
    实验覆盖 4 个模型 (GPT-2 124M, SmolLM 135M/360M/1.7B)、10 代递归训练、6 种解码策略。
    结果 PPL 降低 0.85%–25.65%，diversity 提升 3.44%–14.62%。
  key_findings: "验证 detect-and-reweight 有效防止 model collapse 且优于纯人类数据训练；b 值对模型规模敏感（小模型 b=10，大模型 b=1）"
  differentiation:
    b_selection: "Drayson: 验证集 empirical grid search, per-model 固定 | 我们: α_eff(b) + ESS 约束, per-batch 自适应"
    contamination_setting: "Drayson: 不假设已知比例（原文明确声明），但实验为控制设置 | 我们: 未知比例（batch 统计量在线估计）"
    detector: "Drayson: ModernBERT 150M (AUC=0.986) | 我们: TF-IDF+LR (AUC=0.939)，证明轻量检测器即可"
    theory: "Drayson: 无 b 选取理论（SIR 启发式） | 我们: 收敛理论 motivated α_eff(b) 推导"
    training_scenario: "Drayson: 递归训练 model collapse prevention | 我们: Web corpus 一次性预训练中的未知污染"
    scale: "Drayson: WikiText-2 (~2M tokens) | 我们: FineWeb subset (132M+ tokens)"
    dynamics: "Drayson: b 固定（训练全程不变） | 我们: b* per-batch 自适应"
  our_advantages:
    - "From heuristic to principled: 理论推导 b* 替代 empirical grid search，零额外 validation cost"
    - "Zero validation cost: 无需 validation set 做 b 选择，适用大规模 web pretraining（Drayson 也不假设已知比例，但其 b 选择依赖 validation set）"
    - "Lightweight detector sufficiency: TF-IDF+LR 即可，检测器计算开销降低数量级"
    - "Unified continuous spectrum: b=0 uniform → b→∞ hard filter 的统一框架"
  relevance_to_us: "最直接的竞争者。共享 w=(1-q)^b 公式，但 b 选取方法根本不同——我们的核心贡献正是理论推导 adaptive b*"

  title: "Golden Ratio Weighting Prevents Model Collapse"
  authors: "Hengzhi He, Shirong Xu, Guang Cheng"
  venue: "Under review at JRSSB, 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.18049"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18049"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "从理论推导合成/真实数据混合的最优权重，发现最优权重为黄金比例的倒数(~0.62)"
  key_findings: "在高斯估计、GLM、非参数估计等场景下，当合成数据与真实数据等量时，真实数据的最优权重约为 0.62（黄金比例倒数）。公式 w*=(√(k²+4k)−k)/2, k=真实/合成样本比"

- id: wang_2026_survive_contamination
  title: "Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training"
  authors: "Kevin Wang, Hongqian Niu, Didong Li"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2602.16065"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16065"
  category: theoretical-foundation
  role: "τ（α_eff 质量下界阈值）的理论动机来源；在通用框架下证明污染递归训练仍然收敛"
  method_summary: >
    在最小假设（不限数据分布、允许通用逼近器生成模型）下研究递归训练。
    证明收敛率 = min(基线模型收敛率, α)，其中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是每轮真实数据比例。
    首个不依赖分布假设的递归训练正面理论结果。进一步扩展到采样偏差场景。
  key_findings: "收敛率由真实数据比例 α 下界控制；α 越大收敛越快；即使有污染，只要 α > 0 训练仍收敛"
  tension_with_our_work: >
    论文中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是**已知设计参数**（依赖已知的真实/合成数据比例），
    而我们的 τ 是 empirical hyperparameter（通过检测器统计量在线估计）。
    与 Claim 3（proportion-free）存在张力：Wang 的理论要求知道 α，
    我们的方法不假设已知比例，而是通过 α_eff(b) 间接逼近。
    需在论文中明确讨论：我们的 τ 是 α 的 principled proxy，而非精确值。
  relevance_to_us: "为 α_eff 阈值提供理论合理性——收敛保证依赖真实数据有效比例，我们的 b* 选取正是为了保证 α_eff(b) ≥ τ"
